Punarpoo Dosha if any one of the conditions is satisfied:
1) Saturn in Moon Star or Sub
2) Moon in Saturn Star or Sub
3) Saturn and Moon are conjunct (within 3.20 degree orb) in the same house in the same Zodiac
4) Saturn and Moon are opposing each other (180 degrees + or – 3.20 degrees)
Punarpoo Dosha gets canceled if any one of the conditions is satisfied:
1) Sun is in Saturn Star or Sub
2) Sun is in Moon Star or Sub
3) Sun is conjunct with Moon or Saturn (within 6.40 degrees orb) in the same house & star & Zodiac
4) Sun is opposing Moon or Saturn (180 degrees + or – 6.40 degrees)
5) Saturn in Sun star or sub
6) Moon in Sun star or sub
7) Sun is in a star, lord of which is near either Moon or Saturn
8) Any planet near the Moon or Saturn, but is posited in the star of Sun
